title: Wikipedia Top Pageviews Weekly Civilization Pulse
description: Snapshots the top Wikipedia articles by pageviews for the past 7 complete days, across multiple major-language editions (English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Russian, Chinese, Portuguese). Each row identifies an article with title, language code, total weekly views, view rank within the language, and a category-tag classifier (Person, Place, Event, Concept, Entertainment, Science, Other) derived from title heuristics. Powers the Civilization Pulse Brief: 'what did humanity look up this week' is a leading indicator of cultural attention shifts that anticipate spend / political action / equity sector rotation. Free Wikimedia REST API, no auth.

import pandas as pd
import requests
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
# Use yesterday since today's data may not be aggregated yet
target = now - timedelta(days=2)
year_str = target.strftime('%Y')
month_str = target.strftime('%m')
day_str = target.strftime('%d')

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'article', 'language_code', 'rank',
    'views', 'snapshot_date',
    'category_tag', 'page_url', '_epoch',
]

LANGUAGES = [
    {'code': 'en', 'project': 'en.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'es', 'project': 'es.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'de', 'project': 'de.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'fr', 'project': 'fr.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'ja', 'project': 'ja.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'ru', 'project': 'ru.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'zh', 'project': 'zh.wikipedia'},
    {'code': 'pt', 'project': 'pt.wikipedia'},
]

SKIP_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'^Special:'),
    re.compile(r'^Main_Page$'),
    re.compile(r'^Wikipedia:'),
    re.compile(r'^File:'),
    re.compile(r'^Portal:'),
    re.compile(r'^-$'),
]

PERSON_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(deaths?_in_|elections?|president|king|queen|emperor|prime_minister|chairman|ceo|footballer|actress|actor|singer|musician|artist|writer|scientist|nobel|laureate)\b', re.I)
PLACE_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(country|nation|state|capital|city|continent|island|ocean|sea|mountain|river|empire|republic)\b', re.I)
EVENT_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(war|battle|conflict|crisis|attack|disaster|earthquake|tsunami|hurricane|cyclone|riot|protest|election|championship|cup|olympic|festival|premiere|launch|crash)\b', re.I)
CONCEPT_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(theory|principle|concept|paradigm|movement|ideology|philosophy|religion|economic|economics|policy)\b', re.I)
SCIENCE_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(species|biology|chemistry|physics|mathematics|astronomy|geology|medicine|disease|virus|vaccine|technology|algorithm|programming)\b', re.I)
ENTERTAINMENT_KEYWORDS = re.compile(r'\b(film|movie|tv|series|game|video_game|album|song|book|novel|fictional|character|chapter|episode|season|trailer|reboot)\b', re.I)

def classify_category(title):
    t = title.replace('_', ' ')
    if EVENT_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Event'
    if SCIENCE_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Science'
    if ENTERTAINMENT_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Entertainment'
    if PERSON_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Person'
    if PLACE_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Place'
    if CONCEPT_KEYWORDS.search(t):
        return 'Concept'
    return 'Other'

def should_skip(title):
    for spi in range(len(SKIP_PATTERNS)):
        if SKIP_PATTERNS[spi].search(title):
            return True
    return False

rows = []
for li in range(len(LANGUAGES)):
    ent = LANGUAGES[li]
    code = ent['code']
    project = ent['project']
    url_path = (
        'https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/top/'
        + project + '/all-access/' + year_str + '/' + month_str + '/' + day_str
    )
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            url_path,
            headers={'User-Agent': 'SpeakesQuery research bot (noreply@speakesquery.local)'},
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        items = payload.get('items', []) or []
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not items:
        continue
    snapshot_date = year_str + '-' + month_str + '-' + day_str
    for ii in range(len(items)):
        item = items[ii]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        articles = item.get('articles', []) or []
        if not isinstance(articles, list):
            continue
        for ai in range(len(articles)):
            if ai >= 50:
                break
            a = articles[ai]
            if not isinstance(a, dict):
                continue
            title = a.get('article', '') or ''
            if should_skip(title):
                continue
            rank = a.get('rank', 0) or 0
            views = a.get('views', 0) or 0
            try:
                rank_int = int(rank)
                views_int = int(views)
            except Exception:
                continue
            cat = classify_category(title)
            page_url = 'https://' + code + '.wikipedia.org/wiki/' + title
            rows.append({
                'article': title,
                'language_code': code,
                'rank': rank_int,
                'views': views_int,
                'snapshot_date': snapshot_date,
                'category_tag': cat,
                'page_url': page_url,
                '_epoch': now_epoch,
            })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values(['language_code', 'rank'], ascending=[True, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
